overview.description: The BNY Mellon Muti-Sector Income ETF (BMSI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund actively manages a diversified portfolio of global debt securities, selected through proprietary credit research, and dynamically allocated across sectors. It seeks a high level of current income. BMSI was launched on Jul 27, 2026 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
